base: Unchanged code-anchor policy: at most one original-Core-first5 source fact, then semantic document navigation. Exact/owner and absent-model paths remain lexical-only.
hop: Only the selected code anchor's physical source range, verified source-reference/source-payload rows, exactly one distinct resolved enrolled same-project target. Any unresolved/unsafe/unowned target, self-reference, more than20 matching links or multiple targets suppresses the hop. No recursion or inference from names/URLs; already selected targets are not moved.
placement: Insert one target range after the anchor. Choose highest existing query similarity within the target's enrolled parent rows, tie by frozen row order. Keep all previously selected paths; at a full20 budget remove only a later duplicate range outside first5, otherwise suppress the hop. Preserve cap2/path, original signals and source hashes. Relationship and similarity grant no lexical coverage, authority, currentness, existence or Pack completion.
acceptance: Freeze before scoring all60 observed queries. Preserve the code-anchor control's every positive top20/first5 hit as well as the existing semantic/document-first/lexical gate. Report raw misses separately from structural navigation. Never relax expected paths or count a follow-up hint as an unchanged raw candidate hit.
scope: One test-only source-bound hop over the same frozen parent vectors and verified Core links, no consumer-specific parser, source modification, graph recursion, cross-project traversal, model/weight sweep, raised budgets, production default or Stable change.
